content.text:
The official page is OpenAI's deprecations page: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations. The old URL, platform.openai.com/docs/deprecations, redirects there.

The page lists these shutdowns as coming next, as of today (Oct 16, 2026):

| Shutdown date | Models | Replacement |
|---|---|---|
| **Oct 23, 2026** | Legacy snapshots: gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4.1-nano, gpt-4o-2024-05-13, gpt-image-1, o1, o1-pro, o3-mini, o4-mini, and some fine-tuned models | gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, or gpt-image-2.5-sunburst/flare, depending on the model |
| **Dec 1, 2026** | gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5, chatgpt-image-latest | gpt-image-2.5-sunburst or gpt-image-2.5-flare |
| **Dec 11, 2026** | gpt-5-2025-08-07, gpt-5-mini and gpt-5-nano (2025-08-07), gpt-5-pro-2025-10-06, o3-2025-04-16, o3-pro-2025-06-10 | gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, or gpt-5.6-luna |

Some non-model shutdowns fall in between:
- **Oct 31, 2026:** existing evals become read-only.
- **Nov 30, 2026:** the Evals dashboard and API, Agent Builder, and reusable prompts (`v1/prompts`) shut down.

Later shutdowns:
- **Jan 6, 2027:** tts-1, tts-1-hd, and the gpt-4o-mini-tts snapshots.
- **Jan 14, 2027:** gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, gpt-4.1, and gpt-4.1-mini. This was announced only two days ago.
- **Jan 20, 2027:** the legacy audio, realtime, and transcription models.
- **Feb 26, 2027:** whisper-1 and the gpt-4o transcribe models.
- **Apr 1, 2027:** gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.1, and gpt-5.4-nano.

I read this from a summary of the page, not the page itself. Check the dates and replacements there before you act on them.
